acts.title: Sita Into the Earth — The Letter That Isn't for the
acts.desc: Ahmad ibn Tawfiq's study, Baghdad. Ahmad tests whether you understand the letter is necessary but not sufficient — that the choice to hold remains Maryam's alone. Insight DC 12.
acts.passText: 'Then you understand why I'm sending a person instead of a courier.'
acts.failText: He hands you the letter with minimal context: 'Don't let it be opened.'

acts.title: Sita Into the Earth — The River Road Checkpoint
acts.desc: Tigris river road checkpoint, south of Baghdad. Officer has a list of persons under judicial review. Asks who the letter is addressed to. Deception DC 12: provide a false addressee description.
acts.passText: He stamps it 'private correspondence — personal contents' and waves you through.
acts.failText: Three-day hold. Returned with wax showing signs of examination.

acts.title: Sita Into the Earth — What She Does With It
acts.desc: Maryam al-Basri's study, Basra. Maryam reads the letter, adds a release note, hands both to Fighter. A court official arrives and asks what was handed over. Persuasion DC 13: establish the transaction is complete and not subject to judicial review.
acts.passText: Official notes it and leaves. Fighter exits with both documents.
acts.failText: Official logs 'unknown courier, possible correspondence from Ahmad ibn Tawfiq.' Fighter exits before full inspection.

acts.title: Sita Into the Earth — The Return Road
acts.desc: River road north from Basra. Two of the judge's agents on horseback. Warrant to confiscate 'correspondence from Ahmad ibn Tawfiq.'

acts.title: Sita Into the Earth — The First Distinction
acts.desc: Weimar archive intake desk. Sweelinck creates a new category. History DC 11: understand the distinction between justice and vindication as he describes it.
acts.passText: 'The earth was her choice of court. Let that be the filing note.'
acts.failText: He files both documents. You leave without the category name.
